key_parameters.name: B3 build order
key_parameters.value: Phase 0 version/source lock -> Phase 1 Master Skeleton (envelope, bay planes, S/M/A0, solar roots, interface planes, named equations/design table, unknowns empty/suppressed, export parameter inventory) -> Phase 2 Primary Structure (front/rear frames, 4 longerons, 4 rings, 2 bay boundary decks; no material/section/strength) -> Phase 3 Robot Mount Module (inherit T_SM/flange/adapter refs, adapter + reinforcement proposal + task-face load-spreading frame, reaction chain B601->mount->primary; bolt/locator/load/stiffness null; no vendor STEP) -> Phase 4 Subsystem Packaging placeholders per volume-owner register (no hardware selection, no mass/material authority) -> Phase 5 Serviceability + deployables (panels, tool access, tray extraction, harness corridor reference; solar root/interface, deployed reference + stowed proposal; keepout owners) -> Phase 6 B601 + semantic interfaces (accepted 10-link/9-joint visual identity, verify q0 transform + source hash, keep G/E_virtual; TCP/contact/target-active stay disabled) -> Phase 7 native verification + evidence seal (rebuild/reference/missing checks, inventories, scoped interference per named config, inherit+explain V1 10 q0 interferences, raw/annotated review views, verify V1/Gate/config/URDF/sim untouched, V2 evidence seal + human exit review)

key_parameters.name: pre-start checklist (all 7 required)
key_parameters.value: 1) COMP-PROT-03-A4-B3-V2-SYSTEM-MECHANICAL-CAD human authorization exists; 2) A4-B2 packet 21/21 HASH_MATCH; 3) V1.0 native CAD 32/32 HASH_MATCH; 4) V1.0 seal SHA-256 match; 5) B2.5 input packet hash manifest all match; 6) profile/T_SM/B601 topology/unknown register unmodified; 7) V2.0 output root absent OR human-confirmed legal continuation. Any failure = stop.

key_parameters.name: review views (15)
key_parameters.value: V2-VIEW-01 whole_vehicle_module_overview[EVIDENCE_STATE_REVIEW]; 02 primary_structure_only[STRUCTURAL_REVIEW]; 03 primary_secondary_reference_classification[EVIDENCE_STATE_REVIEW]; 04 three_bay_cutaway[STRUCTURAL_REVIEW]; 05 robot_mount_section[STRUCTURAL_REVIEW]; 06 robot_reaction_load_path[STRUCTURAL_REVIEW, no strength claim]; 07 avionics_EPS_ADCS_volume_owners[SERVICE_ACCESS_REVIEW]; 08 rear_service_zone_owners[SERVICE_ACCESS_REVIEW]; 09 removable_panels_and_tray_directions[SERVICE_ACCESS_REVIEW]; 10 harness_and_service_corridor[SERVICE_ACCESS_REVIEW]; 11 solar_interfaces_and_keepouts[DEPLOYED_REFERENCE_Q0]; 12 stowed_configuration_proposal[STOWED_PROPOSAL]; 13 evidence_state_overview[EVIDENCE_STATE_REVIEW]; 14 V1_to_V2_system_mechanical_delta[EVIDENCE_STATE_REVIEW]; 15 independent_target_scene[INDEPENDENT_SCENE, watermark NO_CONTACT_NO_AUTONOMOUS_CAPTURE_CLAIM]. Global: raw+annotated versions required; configuration+claim_limit visible; source+evidence_state visible; unresolved negative results visible; target_in_active_assembly=false

rules: Master Skeleton 参数合同是几何唯一驱动源；单位 mm/deg/kg；每个参数带 state ∈ {EVIDENCE_BOUND, DERIVED, DESIGN_PROPOSAL, UNKNOWN_BLOCKED, EXCLUDED}
UNKNOWN_BLOCKED 参数必须保持空/suppressed，禁止推断填值：material、section_dimensions、wall_thickness、joints_and_fasteners、T_SB(CS_B)、T_E_TCP(CS_TCP_CONTACT)、T_SC(CS_SENSOR)
Phase 0 只复制输入 manifest，不复制 V1 原生零件；禁止活动引用 OreSat/vendor CAD；记录 A4-B2/B2.5/SSOT/URDF/STL/许可来源
V2 根为独立新根 20_engineering/cad/Space_Embodied_Robot_CAD_V2_0/，预留 14 个顶级目录（00_Master_Skeleton..10_Review_Overlays、Assembly、evidence）
主结构与次结构必须用不同 subassembly/object class；主结构不分配材料、真实截面、连接、强度属性
placeholder 不进入质量与材料权威；不选择具体 OBC/EPS/电池/RW/推进/相机硬件
B601 使用 accepted 10-link/9-joint 只读视觉模型，须校验 q0 transform 与 source hash；保留 G/E_virtual；physical TCP、contact、target active assembly 禁用

每个一级文档必须带 15 项属性：OBJECT_ID, SYSTEM_OWNER, PARENT_ID, STRUCTURE_CLASS, REPRESENTATION_LAYER, EVIDENCE_STATE, SOURCE_REFERENCE, FRAME_ID, INTERFACE_IDS, MASS_OWNER, NO_DYNAMICS_USE, MANUFACTURING_AUTHORITY, EXECUTION_AUTHORITY, CLAIM_LIMIT, BLOCKED_CONSUMERS
每次 interference/clearance 截图与报告必须写明 configuration、joint state、solar state、suppressed components、claim limit；interference 只能按具名配置 scoped 执行
禁以视觉闭环冒充工程闭环：不加装饰纹理/螺栓外观充数、不给 placeholder 分配默认材料、不用 suppress 消除干涉、不把爆炸视图当维护可达性、不把反力链箭头当强度验证、不把 target 放夹爪当捕获验证
必须继承并解释 V1 的 10 处 q0 静态干涉负结果（NEGATIVE_RESULT，global_collision_safety=BLOCKED），评审视图中 unresolved negative results 必须可见
DEPLOYED_REFERENCE_ENVELOPE_MM 不驱动 body envelope（drives_body_envelope=false），claim limit 为 V1 deployed STL reference only
禁止声称：V2 工程完成、标准 12U/发射合规、强度/刚度/模态/热性能已验证、全局碰撞安全已验证、自主捕获/VLA/安全控制已实现（prohibited_claim 原文）
Phase 7 收口必须核验 V1、Gate、config、URDF、simulation 未被改动，并形成 V2 evidence seal + 人工退出审查；B3 退出标准以 A4-B2 v2_review_and_acceptance_matrix.md 为准，不降低 V2-CAD-01..20 任何条件，不自动授权 B4/FEA/动力学/数字孪生
评审视图每张必须出 raw + annotated 两版；target_in_active_assembly=false 全局强制

conflicts_or_gaps: 授权边界冲突（最高优先级）：编排方声明本轮已授权 V2 系统机械 CAD 构建，但所读五份文件一致记录 B3_CAD_authoring_authorized=false、EXECUTION_AUTHORIZED=false、next gate COMP-PROT-03-A4-B3-V2-SYSTEM-MECHANICAL-CAD 为 NOT_GRANTED。开工前检查第 1 条要求该人工授权存在。若人工 Gate 已在文件之外批出，须在构建证据中记录授权凭据；否则按文件应停止。
T_SM 数值缺口：合同中 PLANE_MOUNT_M / CS_M 只给 transform_ref=T_SM，未给数值矩阵；只有 MOUNT_ORIGIN_X_MM=185.25 与 MOUNT_RY_DEG=90.0 两个分量。完整 T_SM 须从几何 SSOT（20_engineering/config/geometry/）取用，且开工检查要求 T_SM 未被改写。
配置清单不一致：构建计划第 5 节只列 5 个具名配置，而 V2-VIEW-15 使用第 6 个配置 INDEPENDENT_SCENE（独立目标场景）。需按视图计划补建该配置或独立场景文件，并保持 target_in_active_assembly=false。
开工检查引用的 hash 清单（A4-B2 21/21、V1.0 32/32、B2.5 input_packet_hash_manifest.csv、V1 seal SHA-256）不在本次精读文件内，构建前须另行核验。
B3 退出验收矩阵 v2_review_and_acceptance_matrix.md（V2-CAD-01..20）在 A4-B2 目录，未在本次精读范围；退出标准以其为准。
solar_left/solar_right 接口 ID 为 IF-SA-L / IF-SA-R，与其余 IF-XX-000 编号风格不同——按原文使用，勿归一化改名。
开放阻塞保留项：10 处 q0 静态干涉 NEGATIVE_RESULT、global_collision_safety=BLOCKED、standard_12U_claim=BLOCKED、profile 为 NON_FLIGHT_DISPLAY_ONLY；V2 构建不得消解或改写这些负结果。
与授权边界一致处确认：禁止项（FEA/材料板厚/URDF 修改/质量惯量权威/physical TCP/相机 FOV/动力学/Git 提交）与文件 authority 区完全吻合，无额外冲突；质量所有权表结果为 PASS_OWNERSHIP_NOT_PHYSICAL_TRUTH，CAD 不得将 placeholder 质量权威化。
notes: BAY_LENGTH_NOMINAL_MM=113.5 与三个分舱边界 (-170.25/-56.75/+56.75/+170.25) 自洽（340.5/3）。Mount 面在任务面 +X 外侧 15 mm（185.25-170.25）。太阳翼根部平面位于中/后舱边界 X=-56.75、Y=±113.15（即 ±Y 体面）。Phase 1 要求建立 named equations/design table 并导出 parameter/property inventory——建议将本合同参数名逐字作为方程名以保证可审计。
